snippet.title: Crownbreakers - Official Gameplay Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026
snippet.description: Check out gameplay from Crownbreakers in this trailer for the upcoming turn-based card-game brawler. Tyrants keep the magical city of Cascade in a chokehold. They grow fat by grinding everyone else's soul into profit. ENOUGH! Crash into their districts and build your deck as you push forward. Use your champions and cards to pummel some demonic billionaires. Crownbreakers will be available on PC.
